pages.title: MELTDOWN MILE — a Blast Corps-inspired clearance racer (WebGL2 vertical slice)

frames.body:
MELTDOWN MILE
LEVEL 1 · HARBOR BEND · VERTICAL SLICE

ATLAS-7, a fusion-reactor hauler, lost its brakes on the cliff road above Harbor Bend. It cannot stop, cannot steer — and its containment fails in 5 minutes. You are the Rapid Clearance Crew: smash, shove and bulldoze everything off its route and get it to the flood-quench pool at the end of the mile.

W / S — throttle / reverse
A / D — steer
SHIFT — boost ram (all vehicles)
E — swap vehicle nearby
R — recover to carrier
P / M — pause / mute

Three rigs, three jobs: BULLDOZER shoves the heavy stuff, WRECKER smashes buildings with boost, SCOUT races ahead to clear the far mile. If the carrier is blocked, its hull burns — fast.
